lines.text: کار فضلا و فساد خون در ابدان و خشکی هوا و سلامتی حیوانات و ارزانی و اب بسیار
lines.en: the work of the learned, and corruption of blood in bodies, and dryness of the air, and health of animals, and cheapness, and much water,

lines.en: of messengers, and the arrival of good news to the court of the king, and the honor of cows and sheep. (The entry of the Sun

lines.en: into the sign of Libra) indicates the moderation of the air, and the cheapness of prices, and the currency of markets, and the weariness of the great,

lines.text: و فراخی طعام و فواکه و عدل ملوك و بیماری یکی از فرماندهان در نواحی مشرق و تفاوت

lines.en: in the price of what they sell by measure and scale, and the goodness of the condition of the commoners, and the inclination of people to women and the people of joy, and much

lines.text: میوها و ریاحین و خوشحالی شعرا و رونق اهل بازار و افتادن کرم در بعضی نباتات*
lines.en: fruits and sweet basils, and the happiness of poets, and the prosperity of the people of the market, and the falling of worms in some plants.*

lines.en: (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Scorpio) indicates the abundance of rain, and the unfairness of people, and the strength of the condition

lines.en: of the corrupt, and enmity among the creatures, and the blowing of winds, and the occurrence of hostilities and disputes, and the agitation

lines.text: شدن احوالها و بیماری و مرك مهتران و اندکی اب چشمها و سردی هوا و بسیاری میوها
lines.en: of conditions, and illness and death of the great, and the scantiness of the water of springs, and the coldness of the air, and many fruits,

lines.text: و شیرینیها و امد و رفت عساکر و تنزل حال حکام و جور و ستم سلاطین بر رعیت و فسق و
lines.en: and sweets, and the coming and going of armies, and the decline of the condition of rulers, and the tyranny and oppression of sultans upon the subjects, and sin and

lines.text: فجور و بیماریها ناخوش و ظهور غیوم و نزول امطار و کثرت میاه خاصه که زهره نیز در
lines.en: immorality, and unpleasant illnesses, and the appearance of clouds, and the descent of rains, and the abundance of waters, especially if Venus is also in

lines.text: کند بر جستن رعد و برق و سرما و قوة حال ملوك و سلاطین و میل نرخها بگرانی و امدن

lines.en: and the ruin of the cultivation of grain, and the unfairness of the creatures, and the sharpness of markets. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Capricorn)

sections.en: On the entry of the Sun into the signs

summary.headline: Sun’s Entry into the Signs
summary.text: Astrological forecasts for the Sun’s entry into Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, covering weather, prices, rulers, illness, agriculture, markets, water, and social conditions. Venus in Scorpio and the sinking of a great person in the Maghreb are also noted.
